abstract_additions: For P1 (g8, k = 2) the mean paired difference was +0.14 percentage points (95 % BCa interval [-0.04, 0.44]) while the median condition log ratio was -0.023; the worst-condition error was 2.09 pp for A1 and 3.89 pp for the best tuned data-driven learner.

For P2 (g8, k = 2) the mean paired difference was +0.23 percentage points (95 % BCa interval [-0.01, 0.59]) while the median condition log ratio was -0.102; the worst-condition error was 2.09 pp for A1 and 4.29 pp for the same network without the physics law.

outcome.title: Physics-informed and data-driven forecasts of lithium-ion capacity fade against the number of cycling tests and check-ups: learning curves with Kolmogorov-Arnold stress functions
outcome.abstract_sentence: With eight cycling conditions and two check-ups per held-out cell, the physics-informed network's typical held-out-condition error could not be distinguished from that of the best tuned data-driven learner (95 % interval [-38.3, 32.9]; n = 40), and a closed-form stress law extracted from its Kolmogorov-Arnold network was not shown to stay within 10 % of the full network, so no closed-form-law claim is made.

For P2 (g8, k = 2) the mean paired difference was +0.23 percentage points (95 % BCa interval [-0.01, 0.59]) while the median condition log ratio was -0.102; the worst-condition error was 2.09 pp for A1 and 4.29 pp for the same network without the physics law.

For K2 (g32, k = full) the mean paired difference was -0.06 percentage points (95 % BCa interval [-0.20, 0.03]) while the median condition log ratio was +0.011; the worst-condition error was 5.80 pp for A15 and 4.48 pp for the equally simplified additive law.
